resources.string: Powers zero-ADB fullscreen overlays, full-perimeter edge lighting gestures, translucent navigation controls, and instant keyboard recovery without reading screen content.

Immersive uses Android's AccessibilityService API strictly to:

• Render full-perimeter binary edge lighting, translucent navigation bars, and elastic sidebars without ADB or root.
• Execute Back, Home, Recents, and Notification Shade actions from edge gestures.
• Detect on-screen keyboard windows to auto-collapse bottom overlays.

Zero screen content, keystrokes, or personal data are ever read, logged, or transmitted.
